# chainlaunch_key (Data Source)

Fetches details about a specific cryptographic key in Chainlaunch.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the key to look up.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) The key algorithm (RSA, EC, ED25519).
- `can_use_in_nodes` (Boolean) Whether the key can be used in Fabric nodes (exportable + was_exported).
- `certificate` (String) The certificate in PEM format.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the key was created.
- `curve` (String) The elliptic curve for EC keys (P-256, P-384, P-521, secp256k1).
- `description` (String) A description of the key.
- `ethereum_address` (String) The Ethereum address derived from the key (for secp256k1 keys).
- `expires_at` (String) The timestamp when the key certificate expires.
- `format` (String) The key format.
- `generated_locally` (Boolean) Whether the key was generated locally.
- `imported_to_provider` (Boolean) Whether the key was imported to the provider.
- `is_ca` (Boolean) Whether this key is a Certificate Authority key.
- `is_exportable` (Boolean) Whether the private key can be exported/accessed locally.
- `key_size` (Number) The key size in bits for RSA keys.
- `kms_key_id` (String) The AWS KMS key ID/ARN (for AWS KMS provider keys).
- `last_rotated_at` (String) The timestamp when the key was last rotated.
- `name` (String) The name of the key.
- `provider_id` (Number) The ID of the key provider.
- `public_key` (String) The public key in PEM format.
- `sha1_fingerprint` (String) The SHA1 fingerprint of the public key.
- `sha256_fingerprint` (String) The SHA256 fingerprint of the public key.
- `signing_key_id` (Number) The ID of the signing key if applicable.
- `status` (String) The current status of the key.
- `vault_path` (String) The Vault secret path (for Vault provider keys).
- `was_exported` (Boolean) Whether the private key was exported (or generated locally).
